bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) echo CREATOR_SOURCE_MISMATCH; exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="faaae3e88c99a7cdfa85a70c91b6b585e3cd7a0d"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo CREATOR_SOURCE_HEAD_MOVED; exit 52; }
stage="$root/.worktrees/creator-entry-faaae3e"
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if test -d "$stage"; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 53
 test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 54
else
 git worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo CREATOR_POLLER_COUNT_INVALID; exit 55; }
running="${ids[0]}"
printf 'CREATOR_PREVIOUS_IMAGE=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$running")"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$running")" = true || exit 56
docker image inspect create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo CREATOR_PRIOR_IMAGE_MISSING; exit 57; }
docker build --pull=false --network none -t create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e -f - "$stage" <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node src /opt/videobot/src
COPY --chown=node:node owner /opt/videobot/owner
COPY --chown=node:node sql /opt/videobot/sql
COPY --chown=node:node web /opt/videobot/web
USER node
DOCKERFILE
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint node -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e --test test/menuPanel.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/stickerWizard.test.mjs
echo CREATOR_ENTRY_IMAGE_AND_RUNTIME_TEST=PASS
echo CREATOR_ENTRY_SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
